lead.en: Save changes → Saving → Saved; the acknowledgement resets after 2.4 seconds.
lead.zh: 保存更改后，按钮依次显示正在保存、已保存，2.4 秒后复位。

rule.en: Host completes the current ticket. Pending suppresses duplicate clicks; stale completions are ignored.
rule.zh: 宿主回写当前请求结果；等待时忽略重复点击，过期结果不生效。

when.zh: 保存、同步等需要就地反馈的异步命令
when.en: Save or sync a change with an in-place acknowledgement.

motion.zh: 新文字上移 2px，在 160ms 内淡入。外壳跟随实际字宽，成功后 2.4 秒复位。
motion.en: The label rises 2px and fades in over 160ms. The shell follows its shaped width; success resets after 2.4s.

lead.en: Publish immediately or open the adjacent menu for three alternatives.
lead.zh: 点击发布执行主操作；箭头展开通知发布、保存草稿、删除草稿。

rule.en: Down opens the menu. Arrows move between enabled options; Enter selects, Escape returns focus to the arrow.
rule.zh: 向下键展开，方向键只经过可用项；Enter 选择，Esc 关闭并将焦点还给箭头。

when.zh: 有默认命令，同时需要提供少量替代命令
when.en: One frequent command and a few alternatives.

motion.zh: 主区随文案改变宽度，菜单展开时箭头位置保持稳定。
motion.en: The arrow stays still as the menu opens. The main segment follows the label width.

lead.en: Related commands share a continuous surface. Try the edit, zoom and save/preview rows.
lead.zh: 连体表面承载相关命令，分别演示编辑、缩放、保存／预览。

rule.en: Each segment emits its own stable id. Zoom +/- changes the percentage; the middle segment resets it.
rule.zh: 每段发出独立标识；中段将缩放重置到 100%。

when.zh: 把共享选区或工具设置的命令排在一起
when.en: Arrange commands that act on the same selection.

motion.zh: 含共享边框，操作组高 44px，缩放组高 36px。高亮随指针滑向相邻段。
motion.en: The rows are 44px high (36px for zoom) including their shared border. The highlight travels between adjacent segments.

lead.en: Spaced controls in a tray; examples include a vertical toolbar and a compact message toolbar.
lead.zh: 托盘内按钮留有间隙，包含纵向画布工具和紧凑消息操作。

rule.en: Arrows skip disabled tools. Undo initially enables Redo. The highlight travels without moving the controls.
rule.zh: 方向键跳过不可用操作；先撤销才能重做。高亮移动，按钮位置保持稳定。

when.zh: 把画布工具或行内工具放进独立托盘
when.en: Build a palette for a canvas or a message.

motion.zh: 常规按钮间距 4px，紧凑按钮间距 3px；分隔线前后留出空间。
motion.en: Regular tools have a 4px gap, compact tools a 3px gap. Dividers add space between sets.

lead.en: Reveal a label in place. Mail, document and publishing actions have separate strips.
lead.zh: 悬停或聚焦时就地展开文字。邮件、文档和发布操作各成一组。

rule.en: Hover or focus an icon to reveal its label. The neighbors slide; with reduced motion widths update immediately.
rule.zh: 指针或键盘移入时文字展开，相邻按钮同步移动；减少动效时立即调整宽度。

when.zh: 工具空间有限，但每项仍需一个可读标签
when.en: Fit named tools into a narrow strip.

motion.zh: 行内首次展开第一项；聚焦下一项时，新旧段宽同时过渡。
motion.en: The first label starts open. Neighboring segments resize together as focus moves.

lead.en: Copy a link or an invite code using the system clipboard.
lead.zh: 将链接或邀请码真正写入系统剪贴板。

rule.en: Copy feedback follows the platform write result. A denied write shows failure and permits a retry.
rule.zh: 收到平台写入结果才显示反馈。浏览器拒绝时保留原文、提示失败，并允许重试。

when.zh: 复制调用者明确提供的文本
when.en: Copy the exact string supplied by the host.

motion.zh: 写入成功后，旧词在 100ms 内淡出，新词在 160ms 内淡入，勾在第 40–260ms 画出，1.9 秒后复位。
motion.en: After a successful write, the old word fades out in 100ms, the new word enters in 160ms, and the check draws from 40–260ms. Feedback resets after 1.9s.

lead.en: Follow a person, save an article, or send an invitation and recover from a simulated network failure.
lead.zh: 原位切换关注、加入资料库和发送邀请；可模拟邀请失败并重试。

rule.en: Keep selected state only after host acknowledgement. A failed invitation can be retried once the connection is restored.
rule.zh: 只有宿主确认成功才改变选中状态；关闭模拟断网后可以重试邀请。

when.zh: 关注、加入资料库和发送邀请
when.en: Follow a profile, collect an article or send an invitation.

motion.zh: 只有变化的文字移动；没有等待文案时，等待按钮收窄为 8px 圆角的图标键。
motion.en: Only changed letters move. Without a working label, the pending button narrows to a square with control-radius corners.

lead.en: Eight reversible icon pairs, including playback, alerts, details and likes.
lead.zh: 八种可反转的图标示例，包括播放、通知、展开详情和喜欢。

rule.en: Enter, Space or a tap toggles the pair. Fast reversals continue from the current stroke positions.
rule.zh: Enter、空格和轻点切换；中途反切从当前笔画位置继续。

when.zh: 同一位置要表达相互关联的两种操作状态
when.en: Show related actions in one stable icon slot.

motion.zh: 八对图标分别绘制线条或填充；反切从当前位置接续，窄屏改为两列。
motion.en: Each pair has its own stroke or fill motion. Rapid reversals continue from the current position; narrow screens use two columns.

lead.en: Delete a sample project, cancel, retry or undo without opening a separate dialog.
lead.zh: 就地确认删除样例项目、取消、失败重试或撤销。

rule.en: Click arms the action. Hold requires one second on the answer; Countdown gives a cancellable three-second grace period after the answer.
rule.zh: 先展开确认，再按选择的模式执行。长按需持续一秒；倒计时在第二次确认后开始，三秒内可取消。

when.zh: 需要让用户确认、取消或撤销的命令
when.en: Offer a confirmation, cancellation and undo next to the affected object.

motion.zh: 外壳宽度变化，命中区可立即操作；长按或倒计时的真实时限不因减少动效而缩短。
motion.en: The face changes width while its answer remains actionable. Reduced motion preserves hold and countdown deadlines.

lead.en: Switch the document theme. Compare Reveal, Eclipse, Split and Rise.
lead.zh: 切换整页主题，分别体验 Reveal、Eclipse、Split、Rise。

rule.en: The host receives the next theme and trigger bounds in window coordinates. Skip the page animation when reduced motion is selected.
rule.zh: 宿主接收下一主题、模式及窗口坐标中的触发范围；减少动效时直接应用主题。

when.zh: 由工具栏切换整个文档或窗口的明暗外观
when.en: Change the appearance of a document or window.

motion.zh: Reveal 从左向右（380ms），Eclipse 从中心扩展（430ms），Split 从中线打开（390ms），Rise 从底部升起（360ms）。
motion.en: Reveal wipes from the left (380ms), Eclipse expands from the center (430ms), Split opens at the center seam (390ms), and Rise moves up from the bottom (360ms).
